p47_hybrid_use.positive: Use certified pair structure and same-stratum naturalistic counter-action witnesses as conditional support geometry.
p47_hybrid_use.negative: Do not use a scalar 'native preference' label or invent pairwise preference supervision.
p47_hybrid_use.decision_target: Predict/support an admissible action set or conditional distribution plus abstention, not a single universally preferred realization.
p47_hybrid_use.domain_boundary: Object NULL→OVERT remains outside the current R8 authorized realization surface.

learned_evaluation: Certified counterfactual pair proximity is a semantic/reference-invariance proxy, not preference accuracy.
Naturalistic frequency differences are conditional support, not utility labels.
A model that collapses all opposite-action supported states into one deterministic action violates P36-R11 heterogeneity authority.
A model that predicts both actions conditionally but abstains outside support is compatible with R6/R11 authority.
